Callout.Name: Jewellery Store Robbery
Callout.Message: Smash and grab at a jewellery store, alarm activated.

Script.Line: They put a brick through the window and took the tray.
Two minutes. That is all it took, two minutes.
They went across the road into the alley. Both of them.

Lines.Approach: They are in the shop and there are bikes waiting outside. Nobody has stopped them yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
